Quirk Endurance.name: Quirk Endurance
Quirk Endurance.description:
🔋 Repeated use has taught your body to keep its Quirk running and to push through the drawback when it bites.

📋 Requires level 8 and Quirk Stamina 8.
🚫 Not available to Quirkless characters.

📈 Grants: Quirk Stamina +10
Quirk Endurance.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has pushed their Quirk past its early limits through repetition: long sessions, back-to-back uses and practice at high Strain. Show it as composure while the Quirk runs: steadier breathing, fewer tremors and less visible distress as Strain climbs. They know their body's warning signs and work through the first ones safely. Limits: Strain still rises at the same rate and the Drawback still shows at its thresholds; this is endurance, not immunity, and a severe technique costs what it always cost. If the character chose Quirkless, this trait does not apply.
